body.promptVi: Viết một đoạn văn nghị luận (6–8 câu): Mạng xã hội mang lại nhiều lợi ích hay tác hại cho giới trẻ? Nêu rõ quan điểm và lý lẽ.
modelAnswers: Social media has become a major part of young people's lives, and its effects are mixed. On the one hand, it allows teenagers to stay in touch with friends and discover new ideas. Many young people have also used it to start small businesses or share their creative work. On the other hand, spending hours scrolling can damage concentration and sleep. Constant comparison with others may also lower self-esteem. In my view, the problem is not social media itself but how much and how we use it. Schools and parents are responsible for teaching young people to use it wisely.

I believe social media does more harm than good to young people. Although it makes communication easier, it often replaces real conversations. Studies suggest that heavy users are more likely to feel anxious or lonely. In addition, false information spreads quickly online, and teenagers may not know how to judge it. Some people argue that social media helps young people express themselves. However, this benefit does not outweigh the risks. Limiting screen time would be a sensible first step.

body.promptVi: Viết 6–8 câu suy đoán về một tình huống (dùng must, might, can't + have + V3), ví dụ: đồng nghiệp hôm nay không đến công ty.
modelAnswers: My colleague Lan didn't come to work today, and nobody knows why. She must have been ill, because she was coughing a lot yesterday. On the other hand, she might have had a family emergency. She can't have forgotten about the meeting, since she organized it herself. Her phone was switched off all morning, so she may have been at the hospital. I hope nothing serious has happened. I'll send her a message this evening to check on her.

When I came home, the living room was a mess and the window was open. My first thought was that someone must have broken in. Then I noticed that nothing valuable was missing, so it can't have been a burglar. The wind might have blown the papers off the table. My cat could also have knocked over the vase. In the end, I found muddy paw prints on the sofa, so it must have been the cat.

body.promptVi: Viết 6–8 câu về những việc bạn thường thuê người khác làm (dùng cấu trúc "have/get something done") và lý do.
modelAnswers: I'm not very good at practical tasks, so I often have things done for me. I get my hair cut every month at a salon near my office. Last year, I had my kitchen repainted because I didn't have time to do it myself. I also have my car serviced twice a year to keep it in good condition. When my laptop broke, I got it repaired at a small shop instead of buying a new one. Paying for these services saves me time, which I can spend with my family.

Living in a big city, I find it convenient to have some jobs done by professionals. I have my clothes washed and ironed at a laundry service every week. I recently got my air conditioner cleaned because it had started to smell. Next month, I'm going to have my eyes tested, since I've been getting headaches. Some people think it's a waste of money, but I think it's worth it. It allows me to focus on my work and hobbies.

body.promptVi: Viết một bài luận ngắn (6–8 câu): Có nên bắt buộc học sinh mặc đồng phục không? Trình bày cả hai mặt trước khi kết luận.
modelAnswers: Whether students should wear uniforms is a question that often divides parents and teachers. Supporters argue that uniforms reduce pressure to wear expensive clothes and help students feel equal. They also say uniforms create a sense of belonging and make mornings simpler. Opponents, however, believe that uniforms limit students' freedom to express their personality. Some families also find buying several sets of uniforms costly. In my opinion, the advantages outweigh the disadvantages, especially in schools where income differences are large. Schools could still allow some choice, such as different colors or styles.

Many schools require students to wear uniforms, but this rule is not without critics. On the positive side, uniforms make it easy to identify students and may improve discipline. They can also prevent bullying based on clothing. On the negative side, teenagers often feel that uniforms are uncomfortable and old-fashioned. Clothes are an important way for young people to show who they are. Overall, I think uniforms are useful in primary schools, but older students should have more freedom.

body.promptVi: Viết một email trang trọng (6–7 câu) ứng tuyển vào một vị trí công việc bạn quan tâm.
modelAnswers: Dear Ms. Tran, I am writing to apply for the position of marketing assistant advertised on your website. I graduated last year with a degree in business and have since worked as an intern at a local advertising agency. During this time, I helped plan several successful social media campaigns. I am particularly interested in your company because of its focus on sustainable products. I am confident that my communication skills and enthusiasm would make me a valuable member of your team. I have attached my résumé and would welcome the opportunity to discuss my application. Yours sincerely, Nguyen Van An

Dear Hiring Manager, I would like to apply for the role of junior software developer at your company. I have two years of experience building web applications and I am familiar with several programming languages. In my current job, I was responsible for improving the speed of our main product. I am now looking for a position where I can take on more challenging projects. Your company's reputation for innovation is what attracted me most. Thank you for considering my application, and I look forward to hearing from you.

body.promptVi: Viết 6–8 câu về một quyết định quan trọng bạn từng đưa ra. Dùng câu điều kiện loại 3 để nói điều gì sẽ xảy ra nếu bạn quyết định khác đi.
modelAnswers: Five years ago, I decided to leave my hometown and move to the city for work. It was a difficult choice because my whole family lived there. At first, I felt lonely and regretted the move. However, I gradually made new friends and found a job I really enjoy. If I hadn't moved, I would never have met my wife. I probably would have stayed in a job that didn't suit me. Looking back, I am glad I took the risk.

When I was eighteen, I chose to study engineering instead of art. My parents had encouraged me to pick a practical subject. If I had followed my heart, I might have become a designer. I sometimes wonder whether I would have been happier. On the other hand, engineering has given me a stable career. If I hadn't studied it, I wouldn't have been able to support my family. I have now taken up painting as a hobby, so I enjoy both worlds.

body.promptVi: Viết 6–8 câu miêu tả một thành phố bạn từng đến và so sánh nó với nơi bạn sống.
modelAnswers: Last year I spent a week in Singapore, and it was very different from my hometown. The first thing I noticed was how clean and organized the streets were. Public transportation was fast and reliable, so I rarely needed a taxi. In my hometown, by contrast, most people depend on motorbikes, and traffic jams are common. Singapore felt more expensive, especially when it came to food and accommodation. However, my hometown has a warmth and energy that I missed while I was away. Both places taught me something about what makes a city livable.

I once visited Hoi An, a small town that seemed to belong to another century. Its narrow streets are lined with old yellow houses and colorful lanterns. Compared to Ho Chi Minh City, where I live, life there moves at a much slower pace. There is far less noise and pollution, and you can walk almost everywhere. On the downside, the town can become crowded with tourists in the evening. Still, I would love to go back and spend more time exploring it.

body.promptVi: Viết 6–8 câu về dự định của bạn trong 10 năm tới, dùng thì tương lai tiếp diễn và tương lai hoàn thành.
modelAnswers: By the time I am forty, I will have worked in the same industry for almost twenty years. I hope I will have become a manager by then. In ten years, I will probably be living in a bigger house outside the city. I will have paid off most of my loan, which will give me more freedom. I imagine I will be spending more time with my children and traveling more often. I would also like to have learned a third language. Of course, plans can change, but setting goals keeps me motivated.

Ten years from now, I will be running my own small bakery. By then, I will have saved enough money to rent a shop in the city center. I will have finished a professional baking course, too. On weekends, I will be teaching baking classes for children. I hope that I will have built a loyal group of customers. If everything goes well, I will be planning to open a second shop.

body.promptVi: Viết một bài đánh giá (review) ngắn (6–7 câu) về một nhà hàng, khách sạn hoặc sản phẩm bạn đã sử dụng.
modelAnswers: I recently stayed at a small guesthouse near the beach, and overall I was impressed. The room was spotless and much larger than it looked in the photos. The staff were friendly and gave us useful advice about local restaurants. Breakfast was simple but fresh, with plenty of tropical fruit. My only complaint is that the walls were thin, so we could hear our neighbors at night. Considering the reasonable price, I would still recommend it to anyone looking for a relaxing stay.

I bought a pair of wireless headphones last month, and they have mostly met my expectations. The sound quality is clear, and the battery lasts for about twenty hours. They are also light and comfortable enough to wear all day. However, the noise cancellation is not as effective as the advertisement claims. The case also feels rather cheap. For the price, they are a decent choice, but I would not call them excellent.

body.promptVi: Viết 6–8 câu bày tỏ sự tiếc nuối hoặc mong ước (dùng "I wish" và "If only").
modelAnswers: I wish I had more free time to spend with my family. These days I work long hours and often come home after my children are asleep. If only I had chosen a job closer to home! I also wish I had kept up with my piano lessons when I was a child. Now I can only play a few simple songs. Sometimes I wish I could travel back in time and give my younger self some advice. Still, I know regret will not change anything, so I try to focus on the future.

If only I had studied harder for my final exams at university. I passed, but my grades were not good enough for the scholarship I wanted. I wish I had asked my teachers for help earlier. I also wish my English were better, because many good jobs require it. That is why I have started taking evening classes. I wish they didn't finish so late, but they are worth it.

body.promptVi: Viết 6–8 câu đề xuất giải pháp cho tình trạng ùn tắc giao thông ở thành phố lớn.
modelAnswers: Traffic congestion has become one of the most serious problems in big cities. One effective solution would be to invest more in public transportation, such as metro lines and buses. If these services were cheaper and more frequent, fewer people would drive. Another idea is to encourage companies to allow flexible working hours, so not everyone travels at the same time. The government could also charge drivers a fee for entering the city center during rush hour. Finally, building safe cycling lanes would give people a healthy alternative. A combination of these measures is likely to work best.

To reduce traffic jams, cities need both short-term and long-term solutions. In the short term, better traffic lights and stricter parking rules could make a real difference. In the long term, urban planning is essential. New housing should be built near workplaces and schools, so people do not have to travel far. Working from home, even one or two days a week, would also take many cars off the road. Without such changes, congestion will only get worse as cities grow.

body.promptVi: Kể lại một câu chuyện (6–8 câu) về một sự việc bất ngờ, dùng thì quá khứ hoàn thành và quá khứ hoàn thành tiếp diễn.
modelAnswers: Last winter, I arrived at the airport only to discover that my flight had been canceled. I had been waiting for this trip for months, so I was extremely disappointed. The airline had sent an email the night before, but I hadn't checked my inbox. While I was standing at the counter, I started talking to a woman who had also missed the flight. It turned out that she had been working in the same city as me for years. We spent the afternoon together and ended up becoming good friends. In the end, the canceled flight turned out to be a lucky accident.

When I got home after a long day, I noticed that the front door was open. I was sure I had locked it that morning. My heart was beating fast as I walked inside. Then I saw my brother in the kitchen. He had been traveling for three months and had come back early to surprise me. He had been planning the surprise for weeks with my parents. I was so relieved that I burst out laughing.
